stage.1.description: Hold the west and prepare for the north bypass and southwest mine road.
stage.2.description: Three crossing approaches converge in front of the base.
stage.3.description: Stop the joint assault from the outer loop and the central bypass.
stage.4.description: Five entrances open one by one along the lava rift.
stage.5.description: Hold off the assault closing in on the central thorium core from all sides.
stage.6.description: Sweep the crystal cave's four-pronged assault away with mine carts.
stage.7.description: Break the five-pronged assault across the marsh with gas tanks.
tutorial.briefing.title: 1/8 · Base and Energy
tutorial.briefing.first: Defend with cards → Mine below → Prepare for the next assault
tutorial.briefing.second: Hold the base through the final assault (starting energy 6)
tutorial.building.title: 2/8 · First Building
tutorial.building.first: Place the Gun Tower on the green round pad.
tutorial.building.second: Select or drag a card to see its range.
tutorial.unit.title: 3/8 · Cost and Units
tutorial.unit.first: Place the Guard on the green tile on the path.
tutorial.unit.second: Spend the remaining 3 energy to stop the enemy advance.
tutorial.combat.title: 4/8 · Combat and Card Cycle
tutorial.combat.first: Played cards go to the bottom of the deck,
tutorial.combat.second: and the next queued card enters your hand.
tutorial.fork.title: 5/8 · Forks
tutorial.fork.first: Tap the blinking barricade to change the enemy route.
tutorial.fork.second: It switches only during preparation; enemies take the open path.
tutorial.scan.title: 6/8 · Free Scan
tutorial.scan.first: Turn on Scan and select the glowing tile.
tutorial.scan.second: Check inside the rock first, then mine safely.
tutorial.firstDig.title: 6/8 · First Dig
tutorial.firstDig.first: Strike the glowing tile to clear the rock.
tutorial.firstDig.second: Uncover the whole vein to collect iron.
tutorial.crafting.title: 7/8 · Crafting Tools
tutorial.crafting.first: Strike the copper vein until it is fully uncovered.
tutorial.crafting.second: Collect 4 iron and 4 copper to craft a T2 pick.
tutorial.investment.title: 8/8 · Next Investment
tutorial.investment.first: Use the T2 pick to mine gold from hard rock.
tutorial.investment.second: Spend gold to recruit cards or add squad slots.
tutorial.complete.title: Practice Complete
tutorial.complete.first: You have learned the basics of defense, mining and upgrades.
tutorial.complete.second: A regular expedition starts fresh with the base deck and starting resources.
tutorial.failed.title: Try Practice Again
tutorial.failed.second: Press Retry to restart from the start of the assault.
